structure: Part 8 read two feature folders of the high-risk-plants linear journey in full, plus four context files. The place-of-destination folder (11 files: page.js, fields.js, evaluation.js, controller.js, controller.test.js, place-of-destination.fit.spec.js, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, copy/copy.test.js, view-model/index.js, view-model/view-model.test.js) is one picker page served at /notifications/{journeyId}/destinations/select: it owns no template of its own, borrowing the shared address-book-picker template through pickerRoutes, and contributes the question's three state-dependent headings and descriptions, the single radio field placeOfDestination, one refusal sentence and a bound picker view model. The party-edit folder (11 files: page.js, party-edit.controller.js, party-edit.controller.test.js, party-edit.njk, party-edit.fit.spec.js, edit-href.js, address-rules.js, address-rules.test.js, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, copy/copy.test.js) is one page rendered at three routes, one per party in the set's party registry (consignors/edit, destinations/edit, consignment/contact/edit): a nine-field form whose labels, lengths, required flags and error sentences are copied from the INS address book, which writes only the notification's own copy of a picked address, with a return marker deciding where Save and Cancel go back to. Context read but not claimed as its own: parties/picked-party.js and parties/index.js (part 7's party registry and copy shapes, read for the editSlug values and the picker's parties copy), address-book-picker/template.njk (part 9's picker shell, read for which context keys the destination page fills), obligations/sections/destination.js (part 12's obligation, read for the rule that one obligation covers all three destination questions), arrival-status/statuses.js (part 6's status values), and the three call sites of edit-href.js in address-book-picker/render.js and check-answers (parts 9 and 10). Covered: the destination picker page's route, maturity, caption, three headings, three descriptions, state rule, field, refusal, role, next page, save controls, back link, hub reachability, held-copy card and accessibility; the party-edit page's three routes, entry points, heading, caption, hint, nine labels, hints, buttons, every validation rule with its message in English and Welsh, its guards, its return-marker rule, its save, cancel and failure behaviour; every copy key of both features in both locales; the 7 own tests of place-of-destination.fit.spec.js and the 5 of party-edit.fit.spec.js; and view-model/index.js and address-rules.js as mechanisms.
